Because PR #93 fixed the historical fixture/lint/type baseline, any new pytest/ruff/mypy failure is blocking unless proven as new unrelated main drift.

Challenge planner isolation, legacy planner retention, policy-vs-execution authority, grant issuer narrowing, TP ID/digest binding, exact ordered allowlist equality, expiry, model ceiling, revocation fail-closed behavior, schema registry substitution, dry-run semantics, tmux propagation and forbidden-path closure.

Any successor after the audited semantic head must be proof-only.
